trap-negation-contrast.evidence: Full read of sim:knot-atom-diagrams (intro, six-item legend, cross-reference closer). No constructions from the ten categories; the six bullets enumerate six distinct rendering conventions, substantive rather than a reflex list. Closer is a cross-reference to rem:knot-atom-diagrams, the documented false-positive class.
trap-negation-contrast.notes: NOT A TRAP, reported separately: this block and its sibling sim:knot-periodic-table give three mutually contradictory particle-to-knot assignments. Here protons are 'solid left trefoils T_{2,3}', neutrons are 'unknots K_{0_1}', and Borromean structure is 'present for Z >= 3'; there protons are Borromean baryons B_3(uud), neutrons are B_3(udd), and the unknot 0_1 is the NEUTRINO. Under the sibling's reading every nucleon is already Borromean, so Borromean structure would be present from Z = 1. Also minor: 'left trefoils T_{2,3}' assigns left-handedness to the standard positive T(2,3), and the mirror is written T_{2,3}^{sigma} here but 'mirror 3_1' in the knot-operations appendix.
